question: Which food component has the highest gross calorific value?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Fats.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fats **have the** highest gross calorific value.**

 
 
• **The digestion of fats **starts from the **small intestine.**
 
• **Bile from the liver makes** the solution** alkaline and breaks down the big fat globules into smaller ones.**
 
• **Lipase from the pancreas** breaks** down the fats further in the small intestine.**
 
• **Intestinal juice** completes the** process of digestion of fats and is absorbed**.
 
• Fats are found in** vegetable oils, animal, fats and other foods like nuts**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Carbohydrates:**

 
 
• They are **sugars and starches and also give us energy.**
 
• They are** found in many foods like cereals, vegetables, etc.**
 
• The mouth or the** buccal cavity is the beginning of carbohydrate digestion.**
 
• **Salivary amylase breaks down the carbohydrates (starch) into sugars with the help of the grinding action by the teeth.**
 
• **Pancreatic amylase digest the further carbohydrates in the small intestine.**
 
 
 
• **About Vitamins:**
 
 
• **Vitamins** were founded by** Funk**.
 
• **Vitamins help to keep the organs healthy, and the systems in good working order.**
 
• It also helps** us to fight germs and therefore prevent disease.**
 
 
 
• **About Proteins:**
 
 
• **The chewed and partly **digested **food enters from the mouth to the stomach.**
 
• **Here the pepsin released** by it digests** protein present in the food.**
 
• **The hydrochloric acid **creates an **acidic environment for the action of pepsin.**
 
• **Trypsin** released in the small** intestine,** from the pancreas,** digests the proteins which are then absorbed after the action of some intestinal enzymes.**
